statements.text: I support federal and state coordination to ensure data centers contribute to economic growth without straining energy or water resources, while also putting people and communities first. This includes strong grid reliability standards, incentives for energy efficiency and water conservation, full transparency in resource usage, and decisions that prevent data centers from being placed in neighborhoods where pollution would harm the health, safety, and quality of life of residents and families. It also means ensuring communities have a real voice in these decisions and are not left to shoulder the environmental, infrastructure, or financial costs of development they did not choose.
